verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any web-facing service, so the axis applies. A direct probe returned HTTP 404 at https://www.eftps.gov/robots.txt, and the evidence shows no other crawl policy. An agent therefore has no machine-readable statement of what it may read.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
